name: Rurinomikoto
source:
The rightful heir of the Mizuho Clan.

From an early age, she has studied the art of rulership to become the next Kyōkō (Imperial Sovereign), ever conscious of her role as a public figure.
As a result, she is a girl of precocious thoughtfulness, constantly restraining herself.
For the sake of her people, she does not hesitate to embrace self-sacrifice.

Politically, much of her presence is “abstract”, yet she is revered by the citizens as the very symbol of the Mizuho Imperial State.

Although she speaks kindly to members of the Rokukyō Families, the complex web of power prevents her from crossing certain walls, leaving her with a sense of loneliness.

“Raise your head. I am Ruri, the 123rd Kyōkō.”

[From [url=http://tech-gj.jp/products/hyakki/chara/index.html#ruri]official website[/url]]
